topic: Tenses – Tests: English Tenses – Complex Test
title: Tense Test: All Main Tenses

explanation.tr:
Bu test tüm temel zamanları karışık olarak sorar. Her soruda:
1. Zaman ifadesini bul (every day, now, yesterday, already, tomorrow…).
2. Eylem bitti mi, devam ediyor mu, alışkanlık mı, plan mı? Karar ver.
3. Özneye göre doğru biçimi seç (he/she/it -s, was/were, has/have).
Hızlı hatırlatma: Simple Present (alışkanlık), Present Progressive (şu an), Simple Past (bitmiş geçmiş), Past Progressive (geçmişte devam), Present Perfect (şimdiye bağlı geçmiş), will / going to (gelecek).
explanation.tk:
Bu synag ähli esasy zamanlary garyşyk soraýar. Her soragda:
1. Wagt aňlatmasyny tap (every day, now, yesterday, already, tomorrow…).
2. Hereket gutardymy, dowam edýärmi, endikmi, meýilnamamy? Karar ber.
3. Eýä görä dogry görnüşi saýla (he/she/it -s, was/were, has/have).
Gysga ýatlatma: Simple Present (endik), Present Progressive (häzir), Simple Past (gutaran geçmiş), Past Progressive (geçmişde dowam), Present Perfect (häzir bilen bagly geçmiş), will / going to (geljek).
explanation.ru:
Этот тест проверяет все основные времена вперемешку. В каждом вопросе:
1. Найди выражение времени (every day, now, yesterday, already, tomorrow…).
2. Реши: действие закончено, в процессе, привычка или план?
3. Выбери форму по подлежащему (he/she/it -s, was/were, has/have).
Напоминание: Simple Present (привычка), Present Progressive (сейчас), Simple Past (законченное прошлое), Past Progressive (длилось в прошлом), Present Perfect (прошлое со связью с настоящим), will / going to (будущее).

examples.en: She was working when I called.
She has already worked 40 hours this week.
examples.tk: Ol bu hepde eýýäm 40 sagat işledi.
examples.ru: На этой неделе она уже отработала 40 часов.

topic: Tenses – Tests: Present Perfect – Complex Test
title: Present Perfect: Complete Test

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect testi. Kontrol et:
• have/has + V3 (he/she/it → has)
• Olumsuz: haven't/hasn't + V3; Soru: Have/Has + özne + V3?
• Düzensiz V3'ler: been, gone, done, seen, eaten, written, taken, bought, made, known
• for (süre) / since (başlangıç noktası)
• already (olumlu), yet (olumsuz/soru, sonda), just, ever, never
• Belli geçmiş zaman (yesterday, ago) varsa Simple Past!
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect synagy. Barla:
• have/has + V3 (he/she/it → has)
• Ýokluk: haven't/hasn't + V3; Sorag: Have/Has + eýe + V3?
• Nädogry V3-ler: been, gone, done, seen, eaten, written, taken, bought, made, known
• for (dowamlylyk) / since (başlangyç nokady)
• already (tassyklaýjy), yet (ýokluk/sorag, ahyrda), just, ever, never
• Belli geçmiş wagt (yesterday, ago) bar bolsa, Simple Past!
explanation.ru:
Тест по Present Perfect. Проверь:
• have/has + V3 (he/she/it → has)
• Отрицание: haven't/hasn't + V3; Вопрос: Have/Has + подлежащее + V3?
• Неправильные V3: been, gone, done, seen, eaten, written, taken, bought, made, known
• for (период) / since (точка отсчёта)
• already (утверждение), yet (отрицание/вопрос, в конце), just, ever, never
• Если указано время в прошлом (yesterday, ago) — Simple Past!

examples.en: I have just made some tea.
We have lived here for ten years.
examples.tk: Biz on ýyl bäri şu ýerde ýaşaýarys.

topic: Tenses – Tests: Present Progressive – Complex Test 1
title: Present Progressive Test 1

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive testi (kolay seviye). Kontrol et:
• am / is / are + fiil-ing
• I → am, he/she/it → is, you/we/they → are
• -ing yazımı: make → making, sit → sitting, lie → lying
• Olumsuz: isn't / aren't / I'm not
• Soru: Is she…? Are they…?
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive synagy (aňsat dereje). Barla:
• am / is / are + işlik-ing
• I → am, he/she/it → is, you/we/they → are
• -ing ýazylyşy: make → making, sit → sitting, lie → lying
• Ýokluk: isn't / aren't / I'm not
• Sorag: Is she…? Are they…?
explanation.ru:
Тест по Present Progressive (лёгкий уровень). Проверь:
• am / is / are + глагол-ing
• I → am, he/she/it → is, you/we/they → are
• Написание -ing: make → making, sit → sitting, lie → lying
• Отрицание: isn't / aren't / I'm not
• Вопрос: Is she…? Are they…?

examples.en: Is he sitting in the garden?

topic: Tenses – Tests: Present Progressive – Complex Test 2
title: Present Progressive Test 2

explanation.tr:
Present Progressive testi (orta seviye):
• Şimdi olan eylemler, geçici durumlar (this week), planlanmış yakın gelecek (tomorrow at 5).
• Wh-sorular: What are you doing? Why is she crying?
• Durum fiilleri (know, like, want, need, believe) -ing almaz.
• Simple Present ile karıştırma: She usually walks, but today she is taking a taxi.
explanation.tk:
Present Progressive synagy (orta dereje):
• Häzir bolýan hereketler, wagtlaýyn ýagdaýlar (this week), meýilleşdirilen ýakyn geljek (tomorrow at 5).
• Wh-soraglar: What are you doing? Why is she crying?
• Ýagdaý işlikleri (know, like, want, need, believe) -ing almaýar.
• Simple Present bilen garyşdyrma: She usually walks, but today she is taking a taxi.
explanation.ru:
Тест по Present Progressive (средний уровень):
• Действия сейчас, временные ситуации (this week), запланированное ближайшее будущее (tomorrow at 5).
• Специальные вопросы: What are you doing? Why is she crying?
• Глаголы состояния (know, like, want, need, believe) без -ing.
• Не путай с Simple Present: She usually walks, but today she is taking a taxi.

topic: Tenses – Tests: Simple Past – Complex Test
title: Simple Past Test

explanation.tr:
Simple Past testi. Kontrol et:
• Düzenli fiiller: -ed (played, lived, studied, stopped)
• Düzensiz fiiller: went, saw, ate, had, came, bought, took, made
• be: was (I/he/she/it), were (you/we/they)
• Olumsuz: didn't + yalın fiil
• Soru: Did + özne + yalın fiil?
• Sinyal: yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010
explanation.tk:
Simple Past synagy. Barla:
• Dogry işlikler: -ed (played, lived, studied, stopped)
• Nädogry işlikler: went, saw, ate, had, came, bought, took, made
• be: was (I/he/she/it), were (you/we/they)
• Ýokluk: didn't + esasy işlik
• Sorag: Did + eýe + esasy işlik?
• Alamat: yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010
explanation.ru:
Тест по Simple Past. Проверь:
• Правильные глаголы: -ed (played, lived, studied, stopped)
• Неправильные: went, saw, ate, had, came, bought, took, made
• be: was (I/he/she/it), were (you/we/they)
• Отрицание: didn't + начальная форма
• Вопрос: Did + подлежащее + начальная форма?
• Маркеры: yesterday, last…, ago, in 2010
